records.region: South-central Alaska, Caribou Creek–Matanuska River–Palmer corridor
records.material_pending_reason: The full selected final westward/northwestward wetland through-link and actual terminal west of Glenn Highway are not established. The original cartography shows the nearby lower Matanuska channels and wetland setting, but the selected extension crosses north of the mapped main channel and continues through marsh away from the depicted waterways. Proximity to the named river, delta context and model connectivity do not supply that missing link.
records.geographic_disambiguation: Bounded named natural reaches and receiving-river context only. No representative identity has been completed for the entire selected synthetic route.
records.completion_scope: Five readable original bounded USGSTopo views were inspected across the entire pinned selection, including the northern opening, Caribou Creek joins, Caribou–Matanuska confluence, glacier-side corridor, middle valley joins, Palmer, lower branches and actual southwestern endpoint. Ordinary regional correspondence is supported for the natural named corridors. A substantive final wetland connection remains unestablished, so this is not a completed naming-scope hold or a second access-pending record.
records.supported_name_scope: Caribou Creek on the upper named corridor, followed by Matanuska River from the Lion Head junction through the long westward/down-valley and Palmer reaches. The final western wetland extension is excluded from the supported name scope.

scope_limits: The formal registry identity, formal name-change vertices, Indigenous-name equivalences and Korean form were not verified.

The maps do not explain whether the final mismatch reflects model generalization, different hydrographic vintages or an omitted channel. No such cause is asserted.

records.region: Eastern Guerrero and adjoining western Oaxaca; Metlatónoc–El Jicaral–La Trinidad–Ometepec–Barra de Tecoanapa corridor.
records.geographic_disambiguation: Representative receiving-river system identity. Santa Catarina is directly labeled on the selected middle/lower trunk; the official technical account also calls the receiving river Ometepec. This is not one scalar name for the chosen upper feeder and separate Quetzala tributary.
records.completion_scope: Completed ordinary regional/corridor correspondence for the chosen headward opening, all three mainstem fragments, separate tributary fragment, intervening joins, adjoining lowland waterbodies, lower side-channel/Cortijo junction setting and actual selected coastal endpoint. Original maps were read in overlapping unobscured windows; a representative system name does not assert a uniform natural channel name, an exact source or mouth vertex, present flow, or registry adjudication.
records.supported_name_scope: Representative receiving-river system identity. Santa Catarina is directly labeled on the selected middle/lower trunk; the official technical account also calls the receiving river Ometepec. This is not one scalar name for the chosen upper feeder and separate Quetzala tributary.

scope_limits: The chosen western Cahuanana/Metlatónoc feeder has no independently established direct name in the inspected map windows.
The official technical prose and state maps have different purposes and generalized name scopes; exact Carrizal/Verde/Santa Catarina naming boundaries are not adjudicated.

The two INEGI state publications have overlapping institutional topographic bases. Their separate publication identity is established, but complete independence of underlying hydrographic data is not claimed.

The lowland contains broad channels, side arms and adjoining lagoons. Ordinary selected-corridor correspondence is established without asserting current discharge, exact lake traversal, exact banks, active distributary status or a modern shoreline.
This is a researched representative system candidate, not formal registry verification or authorization for automatic product naming.

reconstruction_rule: Start from the pinned r46 cumulative index and apply later append-only deltas in verified commit order, rejecting duplicate IDs. publication_boundary: Own factual name/scope findings, public official URLs, bounded geometry metadata and public continuity pins only. No original maps, crops, complete coordinates or private source/derivative/registration fingerprints. Official hosting does not establish source redistribution rights.

research_order.progress_rule: Follow the actual continental order: Americas, Asia, Africa, Europe, then other, with all rivers before lakes. Preserve original queue IDs and ranks for continuity; apply documented geographic deferrals without counting them as name research, and place deferred objects into their corrected later phase by length-descending, stable-ID order. Prior candidate and scope-held assessments remain unresolved where stated.
